title: Job Openings at Scruples Resources Limited
content:
Scruples Resources Limited is a Premier Oil and Gas Support Services Provider. Established in Lagos, Nigeria, Scruples Resources Limited stands as a distinguished leader in the oil and gas industry. We specialize in delivering comprehensive support services, encompassing consultancy, logistics, procurement, engineering, manpower provisioning, and personnel training.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Start-Up Specialist II 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions
     

            
    




	Start-Up Discipline Specialist (Rotating Machinery, Electrical, Process, Document Control Services (DCS), Instrument) focus on field execution of the start-up activities.
	The role is characterized by:
	
		Strong technical skills within the specified discipline (e.g., Rotating Machinery, Electrical, Process, Instrumentation).
		Collaboration with the Project Team, Affiliate Operations, and Contractor to ensure requirements for start-up activities and continuous operations are clearly understood and adhered to.
		Detailed knowledge of operating facilities and applicable processes to put in place to manage risk.
		Leadership to ensure project priorities of safety, quality, and schedule are achieved.
	
	


Tasks and Responsibilities
In addition to all Level 1 tasks and responsibilities, Level 2:


	Work with start-up coordinator & Start-up Manager to ensure that OE/IIF expectations are met.
	Support the Start-Up Manager in the development and execution of the project Start-Up Plan.
	Provide unit specific expertise during planning and to the production coordinators during start-up.
	Act as the focal point for interfacing with the Operations, Integrated Commissioning, and Facility Engineering Teams to ensure a safe and effective planning and execution of start-up activities.
	Development and execution of downstream start-up procedures to ensure a safe and efficient start-up of the project Integrated assets.


Skills and Qualifications


	Previous experience in a closely related position.
	Candidate must have at least 7 years of experience in the oil and gas industry.
	Discipline appropriate certification(s) or equivalent professional experience.
	Proficient in Work Management Systems.
	Effective communication skills; ability to clearly and concisely describe conditions in the field and recommend remediation steps.
	Team Player; exhibits effective teamwork when working with persons over whom the person may have no direct authority and willingness to assist others.
	Ability to adapt to tight deadlines, heavy workloads, and frequent changes in priorities.
	Knowledgeable of Project Completions activities and typical commissioning practices including typical Systems Completion Database software (e.g., WinPCS, MC+, CoConsole, Orbit).
	Proficient in Microsoft Office suite of software programs.


Application Closing Date: 21st October, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Note


	Candidates must have at least 7 years of experience in the oil and gas industry.
	Any candidates who apply without this experience will have their CVs rejected immediately.
	Only qualified candidates who meet the requirements for this position will be contacted.
	Therefore, please ensure your CV aligns with the role before applying.
	Do not apply just for the sake of applying.
	Take your time, align your CV with the  job requirements and specifications before submitting it. This is very important.
	Do not send your certificates, training certificates, NYSC certificate, SSCE certificate, or B.Sc. certificate. All these are not needed.
	Only your CV is required.
	This role is strictly for NIGERIANS!!!! NO EXPERTIATE SHOULD APPLY PLS!!!


 

2.) Maintenance Systems Specialist I 

Job Location: Lagos

Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions


	Maintenance Systems Specialist should have a good understanding of safety, health, and environmental requirements (SHE), able to perform all materials functions to ensure that equipment and spare parts comply with the defined standards and Regulatory requirements and meet planned maintenance needs.
	This Specialist will often work in a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) such as SAP or International Production Enterprise System (SAP outside N. America for production) (IPES).
	This Specialist may have the responsibility to execute contract administration processes and coordinate interfaces post contract award. Typical Job Positions may include: Materials Specialist, IPES Specialist, Global Enterprise Management System (GEMS) Specialist, STRIPES (SAP System for Downstream) Specialist, Contract Administration Specialist


Task and Responsibilities


	Contribute to the achievement of operations having a sustained reliability that complies with all applicable laws and regulations and eliminate potential safety, health and environmental incidents.
	Maintain communications and interface with appropriate Operation, Maintenance and Logistics organizations
	Adhere to the relevant company oi System (oi) / Controls Intergrity (CI) Systems and procedures and contribute to their review and improvement.
	Support Field Maintenance Unit personnel, and provide guidance regarding Procurement processes. Maintain central contract files.
	Act as a liaison between Field Unit and Procurement to ensure contracts and contractors are available to provide goods and services
	Work closely with Procurement for contract renewal, contract award, contract resolutions and contract follow-up action items.
	Help to develop contract work scope, based on provided information from Operations Function owners, Maintenance personnel. Technical pre-qualifications and assessments for new contracts.
	In particular have in-depth knowledge of Computerized Maintenance Mgt. System, proficient at entering and extracting data in support of site maintenance needs.
	Order materials and replacement parts. Document transactions and maintain inventory files. Process invoices and coordinate payments.


Skills and Qualfiications


	Candidates must have at least 7 years of experience in the oil and gas industry. Previous experience in a closely related position
	Behavioral Skills: analytical capability, applied learning, collaboration, effective communication, sound decision-making
	Functional Skills: Safety, Security, Health, and Environment (SSHE) management - operations and maintenance, maintenance planning, maintenance scheduling, maintenance management
	Discipline appropriate certification(s) or equivalent professional experience
	Effective communication skills; ability to clearly and concisely describe conditions in the field and recommend remediation steps
	Team Player; exhibits effective teamwork when working with persons over whom the person may have no direct authority and willingness to assist others
	Ability to adapt to tight deadlines, heavy workloads, and frequent changes in priorities
	Proficient in Microsoft Office suite of software programs


Application Closing Date: 21st October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the  Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note


	Any candidates who apply without this experience will have their CVs rejected immediately.
	Only qualified candidates who meet the requirements for this position will be contacted. Therefore, please ensure your CV aligns with the role before applying. Do not apply just for the sake of applying. Take your time, align your CV with the job requirements and specifications before submitting it.This is very important.
	Do not send your certificates, training certificates, NYSC certificate, SSCE certificate, or B.Sc. certificate. Only your CV is required.
	This role is strictly for NIGERIANS!!!! NO EXPERTIATE SHOULD APPLY PLS!!!


 

 

3.) Wells Advisor III 

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions


	The Wells Advisor job role is meant to convey the generic kinds of experiences and skill proficiencies of a late-career/ Expert-competency level individual in this role. In addition to technical ability, they should demonstrate sound communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
	Resources should be well versed in drilling, well, or construction operations.
	Wells Advisors typically have expertise in one or more job family skills and serve as resources to mentor and develop the broader organization.
	Wells
	Advisors are essential in order to mentor and advise drilling and completion engineers on well planning, well design, and operational surveillance for the safe and efficient drilling and completing of drilling programs.


Task and Responsibilities
In addition to Level 1 and 2 tasks, a Level 3 must:


	Mentor and interface with less-experienced drilling and completion engineers.
	Provide oversight of Drilling programs, and ensure continuity and consistency in practices across multiple rig lines.
	Interface with Affiliate / Business Unit on Logistics, Environmental, Regulatory, Procurement and Cost Stewardship activities.
	Develop and lead longer-term team performance improvement initiatives and engineering studies.
	Make continuous effort to improve efficiencies in Drilling and Completion operations.
	Participate in vendor clarifications, FAT’s and package acceptance
	Review and respond to spec deviation requests
	Review drawings and specifications
	Address human factors engineering as well as safety of personnel and equipment (in conjunction with Topsides and/or O&M contractor)
	Assist in development and review of commissioning and System Integration Test procedures
	Support construction and commissioning efforts as required.


Skills and Qualfiications


	Degree in an Engineering discipline (Mechanical or Civil preferably)
	Candidates must have at least 7 years of experience in the oil and gas industry.
	Advanced analytical and computing skills
	Experienc erequired in construction site management, preferably familiar with Drilling well site design
	Adaptability to changing priorities
	Extensive experience in Drilling Rig development including FEED, Detail Design, Construction and Commissioning
	Strong interpersonal and communication skills
	Ability to organize and progress own work schedule
	Experience working within multi-disciplined team environment involving multiple stakeholders
	Familiar with applicable industry related codes (API, ASME, ANSI, SAE, ASTM, ABS, DNV, SOLAS, IMO)
	Knowledge of Offshore Oil and Gas regulations.


Application Closing Date: 15th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note


	Any candidates who apply without this experience will have their CVs rejected immediately.
	Only qualified candidates who meet the requirements for this position will be contacted. Therefore, please ensure your CV aligns with the role before applying. Do not apply just for the sake of applying. Take your time, align your CV with the job requirements and specifications before submitting it.This is very important.
	Do not send your certificates, training certificates, NYSC certificate, SSCE certificate, or B.Sc. certificate. Only your CV is required.
	This role is strictly for NIGERIANS!!!! NO EXPERTIATE SHOULD APPLY PLS!!!


 

4.) Operations - Maintenance Systems Specialist I 

Job Location: Seplat House, Lagos

Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions


	Maintenance Systems Specialist should have a good understanding of safety, health, and environmental requirements (SHE), able to perform all materials functions to ensure that equipment and spare parts comply with the defined standards and Regulatory requirements and meet planned maintenance needs.
	This Specialist will often work in a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) such as SAP or International Production Enterprise System (SAP outside N. America for production) (IPES).
	This Specialist may have the responsibility to execute contract administration processes and coordinate interfaces post contract award.
	Typical Job Positions may include: Materials Specialist, IPES Specialist, Global Enterprise Management System (GEMS) Specialist, STRIPES (SAP System for Downstream) Specialist, Contract Administration Specialist


Tasks and Responsibilities


	Contribute to the achievement of operations having a sustained reliability that complies with all applicable laws and regulations and eliminate potential safety, health and environmental incidents.
	Maintain communications and interface with appropriate Operation, Maintenance and Logistics organizations
	Adhere to the relevant company oi System (oi) / Controls Intergrity (CI) Systems and procedures and contribute to their review and improvement.
	Support Field Maintenance Unit personnel, and provide guidance regarding Procurement processes. Maintain central contract files.
	Act as a liaison between Field Unit and Procurement to ensure contracts and contractors are available to provide goods and services
	Work closely with Procurement for contract renewal, contract award, contract resolutions and contract follow-up action items.
	Help to develop contract work scope, based on provided information from Operations Function owners, Maintenance personnel. Technical pre-qualifications and assessments for new contracts.
	In particular have in-depth knowledge of Computerized Maintenance Mgt. System, proficient at entering and extracting data in support of site maintenance needs.
	Order materials and replacement parts. Document transactions and maintain inventory files. Process invoices and coordinate payments.


Skills and Qualifications


	Previous experience in a closely related position
	Behavioral Skills: analytical capability, applied learning, collaboration, effective communication, sound decision-making
	Functional Skills: Safety, Security, Health, and Environment (SSHE) management - operations and maintenance, maintenance planning, maintenance scheduling, maintenance management
	Discipline appropriate certification(s) or equivalent professional experience
	Effective communication skills; ability to clearly and concisely describe conditions in the field and recommend remediation steps
	Team Player; exhibits effective teamwork when working with persons over whom the person may have no direct authority and willingness to assist others
	Ability to adapt to tight deadlines, heavy workloads, and frequent changes in priorities
	Proficient in Microsoft Office suite of software programs.


Application Closing Date: 24th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV in MS Word to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Customer Service Representative Job at Global Pay Limited




        
    

        
        Global Pay Limited is a global payment company that values financial and social inclusion. The company provides innovative payment solutions that break down physical borders, boundaries, and social status to enable everyone to enjoy financial and social inclusion.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Representative 

Job Location: Lagos

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Respond promptly to customer inquiries via phone, email, live chat, and social media channels.
	Resolve transaction disputes, failed payments, and account issues in line with service level agreements.
	Escalate complex technical or compliance-related issues to the appropriate internal teams.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and complaints in the CRM/ticketing system.
	Educate customers and merchants on GlobalPay's products, services, and self-service tools.
	Monitor customer satisfaction metrics and contribute ideas to improve service delivery.
	Support onboarding of new merchants and guide them through account setup and verification.


Collaboration & Work Practices:


	Work closely with Operations and Settlements teams to resolve transaction issues.
	Coordinate with Compliance on KYC-related customer queries.
	Participate in shift rotations, including weekends where required.
	Contribute to team knowledge base and FAQ documentation.


Qualifications


	OND / HND / Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
	1-3 years of experience in a customer service or call center role, preferably in banking, fintech, or telecoms.
	Familiarity with the Nigerian payment ecosystem is an advantage.
	Fluency in English; proficiency in a local Nigerian language is a plus.


Required Skills & Technologies:


	Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
	Tools: CRM and helpdesk platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot)
	Problem Solving: Strong active listening and conflict-resolution skills
	Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly learn payment products, POS, and digital banking flows
	Digital Literacy: Comfortable with basic office and messaging tools.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Accountant",
  "description": "Global Pay Limited is a global payment company that values financial and social inclusion. The company provides innovative payment solutions that break down physical borders, boundaries, and social status to enable everyone to enjoy financial and social inclusion.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Accountant&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos

Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records, ledgers, and journal entries.
	Perform daily, weekly, and monthly bank and settlement account reconciliations.
	Support the preparation of monthly management accounts and financial statements.
	Ensure timely remittance and filing of statutory taxes (VAT, WHT, PAYE, CIT).
	Assist with budgeting, cash flow monitoring, and financial forecasting.
	Process vendor payments, staff expense claims, and payroll-related entries.
	Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and schedules.
	Maintain fixed asset register and monitor accounting controls.


Collaboration &amp; Work Practices:


	Work closely with the Settlement team to reconcile transaction and payout accounts.
	Support Compliance with audit trails and financial documentation requests.
	Report to the Finance Manager/CFO on account status and variances.
	Participate in month-end and year-end closing processes.

Accountant Job at Global Pay Limited




        
    

        
        Global Pay Limited is a global payment company that values financial and social inclusion. The company provides innovative payment solutions that break down physical borders, boundaries, and social status to enable everyone to enjoy financial and social inclusion.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant 

Job Location: Lagos

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records, ledgers, and journal entries.
	Perform daily, weekly, and monthly bank and settlement account reconciliations.
	Support the preparation of monthly management accounts and financial statements.
	Ensure timely remittance and filing of statutory taxes (VAT, WHT, PAYE, CIT).
	Assist with budgeting, cash flow monitoring, and financial forecasting.
	Process vendor payments, staff expense claims, and payroll-related entries.
	Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and schedules.
	Maintain fixed asset register and monitor accounting controls.


Collaboration & Work Practices:


	Work closely with the Settlement team to reconcile transaction and payout accounts.
	Support Compliance with audit trails and financial documentation requests.
	Report to the Finance Manager/CFO on account status and variances.
	Participate in month-end and year-end closing processes.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
	3-5 years of accounting experience, ideally within banking, fintech, or a payments company.
	ICAN or ACCA certification (or in view) is an advantage.
	Strong understanding of Nigerian tax laws and financial regulations.


Required Skills & Technologies:


	Accounting Standards: IFRS and Nigerian statutory reporting requirements
	Software: QuickBooks, Sage, SAP, or similar ERP/accounting systems
	Spreadsheets: Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, financial modeling)
	Tax: FIRS and LIRS tax filing procedures
	Reconciliation: Bank and settlement account reconciliation
